thread:
alicia: Quick async follow-up from the PM — we still see the recurring midday burst pattern eating GPU headroom and causing repeated autoscale churn. Splitting into three short tracks (quota soak, scheduler canary, daytime smoke) with owners & targets below. Please ack and call out blockers.

theo: I'll own the quota soak (RW-5120). Plan: request a +12% soft quota for a 72h window during a low-traffic weekend (proposed 2026-08-21 to 2026-08-24). Will include an automated rollback job. Filing request now and pinging cloud-ops.

priya: I'll own the headroom simulation + dashboard (RW-5121). Will run two profiles (midday_burst, end_of_day_flush) and export CSV + Grafana dashboard. Command: `./tools/headroom_sim --profile=midday_burst --out=gs://redwood-tests/headroom/2249998888/` Dashboard path: `/dashboards/headroom/2249998888.json`. Target for upload: 2026-08-18.

mikhail: I'll take the scheduler canary (RW-5122). Proposed conservative change: reduce burst_window to 25s and add soft rate limit on burst_slots. Staging patch example: ```kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -p '{"data":{"burst_window":"25s","burst_slots":"10","burst_rate_limit_ms":"200"}}'``` Canary 48h. Target: 2026-08-20. I'll include a rollback script.

jen: I'll add a daytime smoke job + alerts (RW-5123). Workflow path: `.github/workflows/daytime-headroom-smoke.yml`. Alert: headroom_percent < 12% for 5m between 08:00-20:00 PT. Pager runbook linked in RW-5123. Gate with feature flag `feature.headroom_smoke`. Target: 2026-08-19.

oncall-bot: Incident bot: linked postmortem https://redwood.app/pm/2249998000 and created follow-ups RW-5120, RW-5121, RW-5122, RW-5123.

alicia: Owners consolidated: theo RW-5120 (quota soak) target 2026-08-24; priya RW-5121 (sim+dashboard) target 2026-08-18; mikhail RW-5122 (scheduler canary) target 2026-08-20; jen RW-5123 (smoke+alerts) target 2026-08-19. I'll run 10-min async check-ins Mon/Wed until these are closed. Next sync: 2026-08-16 09:00 PT.

theo: Metrics to capture during soak: `gpu_alloc_rate_p95`, `headroom_percent_p5`, `scale_up_count_1h`, `eviction_rate`. Will export CSVs to RW-5120.

priya: Adding `queued_batches_p99`, `inflight_batch_size_avg` and `headroom_sim_scenarios` to dashboard. Will attach a short notebook summarizing sensitivity.

mikhail: Canary success criteria: headroom_percent_p5 improves or at least no regression in tail latency; rollback if preempt_count + tail_latency_p99 worsens >20% vs baseline. Revert script: `kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -p '{"data":{"burst_window":"45s","burst_slots":"16","burst_rate_limit_ms":"100"}}'`

jen: Smoke job will be feature-flag gated and include a mute window. Pager runbook will include manual rollback commands and contact list.

alicia: If anyone hits RBAC/cloud blockers ping me directly. Please ack.

theo: Ack — pinging cloud-ops now.

priya: Ack — running sim tonight and will post link.

mikhail: Ack — will schedule canary after sim.

jen: Ack — creating PR for smoke workflow + alerting.
